verdict.rationale: Sill's optional virtual display moves a streamed window onto a display of its own on the Mac, so the iPad shows content that is no longer on the main screen rather than a mirror of it [sill-gh-9]. Otherwise Sill streams a single Mac window or the whole existing desktop to the device [sill-docs-1]. The virtual display is documented only as a way to keep a covered window updating, scoped to one window, not as a general extended desktop. Missing for 10: a full extended-desktop mode where the device acts as a second monitor you can drag any windows onto, arrangement/resolution controls for that display, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
